profile.headline: Software Engineer at Loancrate | Ex-Square, ServiceNow
profile.summary: I'm Yony, it's like Tony but with a 'Y'.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Architected POS Modes, the Tier-0 configuration engine consolidating 5 vertical POS apps into 7 unified seller modes — feature discovery among new sellers grew nearly 80%. Also served as Web DRI for Device Profiles v2, owning the TypeScript/Ember dashboard rollout across 11+ engineering teams.
 
Led the offline-first sync migration for Square's top-3 cash management addon, resolving discrepancies at ~13% of merchant locations — built a bridge architecture with feature-flag-controlled cutover, domain versioning infrastructure, and end-to-end acceptance testing; full backend rollout completed across 1M+ annual shifts.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Apollo GraphQL · gRPC · Protocol Buffers · SQL · Agentic Engineering · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Working in a small, full-stack, and customer-focused team to triage, investigate, and resolve high-priority case tasks raised for customers.
- Mentoring junior and summer intern engineers in the organization by providing them technical guidance and as a point of contact for technical questions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Maintaining and improving the platform’s search experience including REST and GraphQL APIs, various custom web components, and services like text search queries, suggestions, and analytics.
- Lead frontend and Java backend design and collaborated with various teams to bring a new search result called “Genius Results” in both web and mobile; aimed at transforming the platform’s search experience into a more Google-like one.
- Lead the migration of two existing custom React-based web components to be configurable, function in the platform’s new UX framework, and be backward compatible
- Participated in the design and implementation of an analytics framework to track search analytics and power the suggestion service. Additionally, built an NPM package that is used by various web components to communicate with the aforementioned framework.
- Participated in the design and implementation of a new platform framework called Declarative Actions that enables customers and application teams to add custom functionality to sections in their workspace without writing custom scripts and declaratively control their visibility.
- Improved web accessibility among various core UI components that resulted in UX mandates to ensure teams build web elements that meet WCAG 2.0 criteria.

positions.title: Business Analyst Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Analyzed Cisco’s installed products database using market basket analysis and collaborative filtering to build a recommender system model for cross-selling Cisco Products
- Built analysis pipelines in Python and R and communicated insights to management team to guide strategic planning
- Leveraged my background in math and computer science to implement features on top of our model.

positions.title: CSE 12, 15L & 110 Tutor
positions.description: Tutor for students in CSE12, Basic Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design (OOD), and CSE15L, Software Tools and Techniques Laboratory, which includes tasks such as assisting students individually and in groups, providing insight and advice to maximize students’ understanding, guiding students on approaches to problem solving, and evaluating of student programming assignments.

positions.title: Web/Database Assistant
positions.description:
Update and manage the department’s website through WordPress by modifying existing PHP files, adding new features, and embedding outside services such as Eventbrite.
Using MySQL, Node.js, and AngularJS, designed a database and user interface to optimize the department’s tracking of contacts, events, and programs.

positions.title: Math and Reading Tutor
positions.description: Work on-on-one and in small groups with students from elementary through middle school grade, and help them solve and understand the lessons taught in class. In addition, serve as a role model and encourage students to read and solve math problem by reinforcing its importance.

projects.title: Object Oriented Design
projects.description:
Performed a case study analysis of approaches to Object-Oriented Design in C, C++, and Java to recommend which approaches are best suited to solve programming problems. The nine projects implemented a stack-based calculator that evolved to utilize binary trees, circular linked lists, and
hash tables.  The efficiency of each data structure was analyzed after each project iteration.
